Analizar resultados, identificar desviaciones, tendencias, oportunidades y riesgos, y proponer recomendaciones y planes de acción a la Gerencia. Elaborar y presentar informes ejecutivos con insights de negocio para la toma de decisiones de la Gerencia y la Alta Dirección. Identificar e implementar automatizaciones y mejoras en los procesos de extracción, transformación y reporte de la información, reduciendo tareas manuales y tiempos de entrega. Apoyar los procesos de planeación, proyección de metas, presupuesto y medición del desempeño comercial. Documentar los procesos, fuentes de datos, reglas de negocio y metodologías de cálculo de los indicadores. Desarrollar, capacitar y evaluar el desempeño del equipo a cargo, promoviendo el aprendizaje continuo y una cultura orientada a datos. ¿Qué necesitas? Deseable especialización en Analítica de Datos, Inteligencia de Negocios (BI), Ciencia de Datos, Finanzas o Gestión Estratégica. Experiencia Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en análisis de información, inteligencia de negocios, planeación o áreas afines. Mínimo 1 año con personal a cargo, liderando equipos. Conocimientos técnicos Excel avanzado (tablas dinámicas, Power Query, Power Pivot, fórmulas avanzadas, automatizaciones y manejo de bases de datos). Análisis de datos y estadística aplicada. Identificación de oportunidades y riesgos. Capacidad de síntesis y elaboración de recomendaciones estratégicas.

We help brands turn them into a better customer experience, more exchanges instead of refunds, and less work for their teams. 400+ brands run their returns on 8returns, including Tommy Hilfiger, Reebok and Fielmann. The role You'll be the first person at 8returns who works on content full-time. You'll own our content across all channels, from LinkedIn and video to the website and product launches. Most of it will be in German, and you'll work directly with the founders. What you'll do - Make short videos: explainers, customer stories and a look at how we work. - Run our company LinkedIn and help the founders post on their own profiles. - Write our newsletter and grow its readership. - Write and update website content: landing pages, blog articles and customer stories. - Plan and create the content for product launches and new features, together with Product. - Talk to Sales and Customer Success to find topics, and turn customer conversations into content. - Come up with formats you can repeat, and post regularly. - Look at the numbers to see what works, and change course when something doesn't. What you bring - Native-level German, written and spoken. You'll write most of our content in German. Fluent English on top. - 2–4 years of experience in content, social media or marketing. - You've built an audience or grown an account before. It doesn't have to be a huge one. - High agency: you see what needs doing and get it done without being asked. - You write well and know what good content looks like. - You can film and edit a video yourself and are fine being on camera. - You know LinkedIn and short-form video well. - You use AI tools in your daily work. - A link to something you've made is a plus, but not required. You don't have to tick every box. If this sounds like you, apply. What we offer - Competitive salary - Fully remote, with regular team meetups in Berlin - Responsibility from day one, and the chance to lead content at 8returns as we grow - Close work with the founders and direct contact with customers Hiring process 1. Intro call (15 min) 2. Deep dive with a live work task (60 min) 3. Call with our founder (30 min) 4. Paid trial day 5. Reference checks and offer We try to get through this in about two weeks.
